adultEquivalentDemand.verdict: CORRECT AND SINGLE — an adult on a journey still eats

laborCapacity.verdict: UNDER-CHARGE — the carrying-capacity labor term does not fall when the party leaves

sameDayPartySizing.formula: adults = max(1, workingAdults - awayWorkers); party = max(1, min(cap, round(adults * baseShare)))
sameDayPartySizing.verdict: SINGLE DEDUCTION, scales the PARTY not the band

mobilityPools.verdict: SINGLE DEDUCTION, releases on terminal phase

provisions.verdict: ZERO BAND-FOOD COST for information-only tasks — buildReturnedRecord never runs without a pendingReturnRecord, so a frontier party's provisions are notional

bandFatigue.verdict: ABSENT — a two-person party's walking imposes no whole-band fatigue penalty

interpretation: Every physical cost is charged exactly once, reservation matches party size, labor releases on terminal phase, and person-days are step-mode invariant. Two of the accounting paths UNDER-charge rather than double-charge. Per §12 and §14 this forbids tuning the cost away: the population difference must be explained elsewhere (see the §10/§11 waterfall and amplification audit).
